name: isti_institutional_grants
_curated_note: A dedicated notice board: every row is a published call, RFP or tender notice, so rows are exempt from the funding-vocabulary test in opportunity_gate.py.
_note: 19 records ('Total number of Record(s): 19'), 10 on ?page=0, 9 on ?page=1 (measured 2026-09-30). The listing prints NO deadline — these are standing schemes, not dated calls. Undated rows are hidden by the strict Active rule and retired by audit_deadlines after LOP_ONGOING_MAX_AGE_DAYS, so expect them stored and not shown unless a detail page yields a date.
_page_url_note: Drupal pagination is 0-BASED: ?page=0 is the first page, ?page=1 the second. {offset} with page_size 1 produces exactly that; {page} would skip the second page and start at the third.
_requires_js_note: Plain HTTP on purpose: the listing is server-rendered (read without a browser on 2026-09-30). The generic default renders every source in Chromium when Playwright is installed, which here only adds cost — and on a host without Playwright it logs a warning each run.
_title_selector_note: Only links of this shape are rows. The first EC2 run found MORE rows than the site's own counter (22 against 19); a surplus against the site's count can only be links that are not listings — category, sidebar or sibling-section links sharing the page. Every real row links to a detail page of this shape. For ISTI that is a child of the listing path: <listing>/<scheme-slug>. The surplus matched the number of sibling sections in the sidebar.
_funding_signal_note: OFF because this is a dedicated board and title_selector already restricts rows to detail links. Listing titles such as 'RFQ for Purchase of Laptops' or 'Annual Rate for Delivery and Installation of Interactive Panels' carry no funding vocabulary and were being dropped INSIDE the parser — before any report could count them. is_furniture, the same-page test and the nav-href test still apply.

name: fire_biofin
_note: First EC2 run 2026-09-30: 34 pages walked before a 30s render timeout on page 35 ended the walk; the site claims ~49 pages / 435 resources (unconfirmed). base_scraper now retries a failed render once. Rows are funding PROGRAMMES (EU LIFE, Band Foundation), not dated calls, so the opportunity gate is left ON.
_title_selector_note: Every FIRE resource is /single/<slug>. The first EC2 run extracted 292 rows over 34 pages of which 81 repeated a URL already seen (27.7%) and 38 failed the opportunity gate. Restricting to /single/ links removes any sidebar or article link that appears on every page. If repeats persist AFTER this, they are real listing rows moving between pages — an unstable sort order on the site — and some rows are then never seen at all.
_page_url_note: 1-based ?page=N, as the site's own pager uses (the log shows http://fire.biofin.org/?page=35).
